evidence_boundary.promotion_rule: Financial or market material may be registered as a scoped research signal or indicator only after a separately versioned, reproducible, leakage-safe experiment meets its pre-registered acceptance criteria and completes independent review. Promotion does not create trading advice, a causal claim, or a guaranteed forecast.
non_claims: No untested association is a validated signal.
A statistically reported association is not proof of a causal mechanism.
A promoted research signal is not a buy, sell, hold, allocation, or execution instruction.

contract.purpose: Specify the first leakage-safe temporal validation run; this is not an execution log and contains no performance result.
eligible_dataset_conditions: dataset manifest, data card, feature dictionary, label dictionary, and source inventory are frozen and hashed
every row passes the feature-cutoff validator or has a recorded exclusion
historical observation window and final holdout dates are pre-registered
baseline definitions and acceptance criteria are pre-registered
rights status is resolved for all included sources

default_split_design.training_window: Declared minimum historical duration; expand only forward in time for the expanding variant.
default_split_design.validation_window: Contiguous future period with explicit start and end timestamps.
default_split_design.step_size: Declared chronological increment, recorded in the split manifest.
default_split_design.purge_policy: Remove train rows whose outcome windows overlap the validation period.
default_split_design.embargo_policy: Apply a declared post-train/pre-validation temporal gap when outcome dependence or publication lag requires it.
default_split_design.final_holdout: A later untouched chronological interval used exactly once after candidate selection.

first_execution_steps.action: Approve or reject the frozen experiment record, hypothesis card, and source-rights inventory.
Acquire actual historical observations using the approved source decision records, preserve raw responses, and hash every artifact.
Normalize the data, create availability timestamps, profile missingness and duplicates, and record all exclusions.
first_execution_steps.output: normalized observation dataset and data-quality report

first_execution_steps.action: Generate deterministic astrology features with explicit engine and tradition settings; preserve raw and transformed feature values.
Construct independently defined labels after the cutoff plus censor gap; validate target windows and label versioning.
first_execution_steps.output: label dictionary and label validation report

first_execution_steps.action: Freeze the dataset, calculate its manifest hash, run temporal-leakage validation, and stop if unresolved violations remain.
first_execution_steps.output: frozen dataset manifest and leakage audit

first_execution_steps.action: Materialize chronological folds with train, purge, embargo, validation, and final-holdout boundaries.
Fit the declared naive and feature-ablated baselines separately within each fold, then fit the pre-registered candidate using only training rows.
first_execution_steps.output: fold-local model artifacts and baseline metrics

first_execution_steps.action: Evaluate each fold without retuning on validation outcomes; report metrics, intervals, missingness, exclusions, regime context, and negative results.
Aggregate fold-level outcomes according to the registered metric and decision rule; preserve failures and instability rather than selecting favorable windows.
If and only if candidate selection is complete, evaluate the untouched final holdout once and create an experiment record and model card.
Submit the completed package for independent review against the promotion-gate contract.
